# LYU.ai

> Transcend our limits. Enjoy being alive.

LYU.ai is an independent AI company building intelligent agents for robotics, healthcare, and productivity.

- Website: https://lyu.ai
- GitHub: https://github.com/lyuai
- Contact: mailto:hi@lyu.ai

## Vision

Technology reaches its highest purpose when it helps humanity outgrow its boundaries and sets people free to live. Rather than competing for human attention, our agents quietly shoulder physical strain, health complexity, and cognitive friction — returning time, vitality, and creative freedom to human life.

## Focus

1. **Agents for Robotics**: Embodied intelligence that perceives, adapts, and acts safely in the physical world.
2. **Agents for Healthcare**: Attentive partners supporting human longevity, preventive understanding, and continuous care.
3. **Agents for Productivity**: High-craft collaborators that turn intent into enduring work and amplify individual capability.
